summary: NewMarket Corp filed an 8-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders, including election of seven director nominees, ratification of auditor, and advisory approval of executive compensation, plus a disclosure of a declared $3.00 per share quarterly dividend payable July 1, 2026. This is a routine current report covering standard shareholder voting outcomes and a regular dividend announcement. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, or restructuring is present. The filing is ordinary-course, not triggering a special-situations classification.
